thread:
Andrea: quick sync — can we decide priority bucket for thalia-34b onboarding? want to run FP16->4bit quant smoke + eval suite next week. timeline pressure from product for embeddings perf. any objections?
Sam: +1 from infra. need estimate of GPU-hours. how many sequences per eval?
Andrea: plan: 2k eval prompts (synth+prod-sampled), 1k embedding pairs, latency bench at 1k seq. estimated ~12 GPU-hours on A100-40GB.
Jin: curious on quality gates — what fail thresholds are we using?
Margo: propose gating: embedding cosine drop < 0.02 vs baseline => pass; generation Rouge-L drop < 3 pts => pass; safety regressions >5% => block. also check token-level hallucination rate.
Eva: add quant smoke checklist: run int8 and q4 calibrations with 1k prompts, check perplexity delta, sample outputs for safety/toxicity, verify kv-cache and streaming correctness.
Sam: capacity note: Dedicated pool has a 48h slot free starting Tue; can schedule there to avoid noisy neighbors. also suggest using burst capacity only for latency bench to keep costs low.
Andrea: can someone own scheduling + scoring? @Ryan? (I can if needed)
Ryan: I can own scheduling and the basic eval harness. will update the intake sheet and add estimated cost. ETA Mon EOD.
ops-bot: reminder: please tag ticket in #eng-releases for reserved capacity booking :calendar:
Andrea: canary rollout plan draft: canary = 5% traffic -> monitor latency & hallucination evals -> full rollout if no alerts in 4h. fallback = baseline-13b.
Margo: also add model variant naming: thalia-34b.fp16, thalia-34b.q4_0, thalia-34b.q8_0 so experiments are traceable.
Jin: one more item: include model card note about training data cutoff and known failure modes; product needs that for compliance review.
Andrea: next steps recap: Ryan schedule slot + create ticket, Margo maintain gating spreadsheet, Jin draft model card snippet. check-in Wed 10:00am. :thumbsup:
Ryan: added to calendar, created intake ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/ML-1234
Andrea: closing loop — thanks team!
